strings.FLR_NEU_CONTROL: {flr_getnamedef} is controlled by A NEUTRAL PARTY.
strings.FLR_fearful_victory_desc: The triumph over degenerated National Socialism was a welcome development to the Flemish SS - but not for long. Now that the final struggle is over, Eriksson has suddenly realized that Flanders is surrounded by prowling wolves, and feels very, very alone.
strings.FLR_eyes_on_the_border_desc: Léon Degrelle makes no bones about his ambitions; he wants Belgium back together. The Walloon Legion is quite the force to be reckoned with, something Eriksson is acutely aware of. He has thus prepared his SS to defend Flanders at all costs.
